scope-of-inspection.userComment: When captured data is available for Section 01, include the number of roof plates measured and the readings-per-plate coverage rather than using only generic method language.
scope-of-inspection.confirmedRule: For Section 01, whenever the package includes roof UT coverage, explicitly state the number of roof plates measured and the readings-per-plate coverage in the scope checklist, provided those counts are supported by captured data.
scope-of-inspection.governanceNote: In the future multi-tenant product, this type of durable logic change must be approved by a platform admin before activation.
